column3: Ayase Route ・ Ayase's Date Arc
And so, the promised day with Ayase arrived.
...Hey.
Yes?
I've been wanting to say something since we got off the train, but... would you mind?
What is it?
Why are we together in Akiba?
Indeed. Having followed Ayase, the place that we'd finally arrived at was Akihabara.
This is a place that should have absolutely no connection whatsoever to Ayase, so what are we doing here?
I can't help but think she's planning something.
...What the hell is she thinking?
Well, I was thinking that maybe you could show me around this place today, Onii-san.
W-What...?
You... want me to show you around Akiba?
Yes.
Well... I wanted to try going to the places that Kirino usually goes to.
Ah... That's it.
Now that I think about it, that should've been obvious.
Everything Ayase does has to do with Kirino.
So this is take two of 'Operation Overcome Otaku-phobia', huh.
...Yes.
It's not like she wanted to go on a date with me anyway.
Thinking of it that way... it doesn't really hurt that much.
*sigh*
E-Eh? Um... Onii-san?
Hm? What?
Onii-san, you... know a lot about this place and all... Do you like it?
Well, more than you at least.
...Then it might be suitable to play around here as a way of returning the favor.
Wait, could Ayase have taken me into consideration and chosen Akiba because of that?
Seems like we're not quite in the clear yet.
Eh?
Despite what you think, I'm not that deep into otaku culture.
I-Is that so?
Yeah, so I'm not really all that familiar with Akiba.
It's usually just Kirino dragging me along.
Then... I guess it won't do to choose this place to go to as a way of saying thanks...
I'm sorry, I--
Ah, it's fine. Don't worry.
In fact, I'm quite happy that you even thought about me.
Really?
Yeah.
Leave it to me. I'll take you to the places Kirino usually goes to.
Okay! Thank you very much!
However, regarding the places that Kirino frequents...
Where would be appropriate to bring Ayase?
Hmm...
One place automatically came to mind, but bringing Ayase to "that place" is definitely out of the question.l
That place is on a whole different level.
Today I'll bring her somewhere more common and gradually melt her prejudice.
Onii-san, where are we going first?
How about a place that sells 【H-games】?
Definitely not! W-Why would we go to a place like that?!
Didn't you say you wanted to go to places that Kirino usually goes to!?
Onii-san, you're doing it on purpose, aren't you?
D-Doing what?
You looked as if you were enjoying yourself just now.
Heh, you found out.
You're even delighted when I kick you... You're really a pervert.
It's not like I want you to kick me! I'm not that perverted!
A-Anyway...
I-I did say that I... wanted to properly understand Kirino's hobby.
But on second thought, 【H-games】 are still too much.
Alright, I get it.
Today I'll bring her somewhere more common and gradually melt her prejudice.
Our first stop was...
The doujin shop that Kirino frequents.
It shouldn't be a problem bringing Ayase here, since the first floor is more or less an ordinary book store..
Uu... It's all manga here...
Huh? She's already bailing?
Say, do you hate manga?
...I neither hate nor like it.
So she's totally uninterested then.
...This'll be tricky.
If she can't see why manga can be interesting... She'll have a hard time accepting this hobby..
Want to try reading a manga that Kirino likes?
Eh?
Let's see... This, this and this over here, Kirino mentioned they're pretty interesting...
I picked a couple of volumes which Kirino likes and showed them to Ayase.
I've read these since Kirino forced me, but they're mainly aimed at girls..
These aren't strange at all, so you should try them.
O-Okay. I'll try reading them when I get home.
Great, you do that.
I'll just go and pay for them, so just wait here.
Eh... I'll pay.
It's okay. I picked them for you anyway.
Ah, thank you very much.
She minds even the smallest details, huh.
Ayase was gone when I returned from the register.
Huh? Where did she go?
I looked around the shop but she was nowhere to be seen.
S-She couldn't have...
O-Onii-san!
Whoa!
W-What is wrong with this store?! As I stepped onto the second floor... H-H-H-books everywhere-!
That's just what they sell here.
I-I knew you brought me here so you could sexually harass me!
That's a misunderstanding! It's not my fault you went up to the second floor without looking at the signs!!
U-Uu... But... But...
I can't take it anymore... Let's go out.
...Are you okay?
So walking around Akiba with Ayase is still impossible, I see!
It was a light one this time, but...
M-My stomach still hurts...
